sections.heading: Why Burkina Faso Needs a *Smart Electricity Network*
sections.intro: The energy gap in West Africa is real and urgent. Ba-Suka solves the three interconnected barriers which prevent electric mobility adoption — making clean electricity accessible where it matters most.

items.title: The Grid-Access Gap
items.body:
81% of Burkina Faso lacks reliable electricity access.

Ba-Suka Solution: Solar-powered stations provide energy independence.

items.title: Professional Swap Stations
items.body:
Zero professional battery swap stations exist — Ba-Suka is building the first network.

Ba-Suka Solution: Yennenga Warriors operate professional stations.

items.title: Battery Cost Barrier
items.body:
Batteries represent 60-80% of EV vehicle cost.

Ba-Suka Solution: Pay-per-swap eliminates ownership costs.

items.title: Data Management System
items.body: Real-time network optimization using IoT data to monitor battery health, location, and station demand across Burkina Faso.

items.title: Ba-Suka Academy
items.body: Professional energy infrastructure training. Module-based learning in PV systems, IoT monitoring, and leadership for our future station managers.

items.title: Swap & Glow™ Stations
items.body: 100% solar-powered, Sahel-rugged stations designed for extreme heat and dust. Vertical battery swapping reduces swap time to under 60 seconds — faster than traditional charging.

items.title: Multi-Use Platform
items.body: The same SIRA™ battery powers JOLA™ electric bikes, tricycles, commercial kiosks, and household appliances. One battery type serves multiple use cases, maximizing utilization.

items.title: <60 Second Swaps
items.body: Instant energy exchange. Riders arrive, swap their depleted SIRA™ battery for a fully charged one, and get back to work in under a minute.

items.title: Women-Led Infrastructure
items.body: Yennenga Warriors are not a CSR initiative — they are the operational core. Professionally trained women manage stations, handle customer relationships, and lead community engagement.

sections.heading: Our Mission & Vision
sections.body:
Building Burkina Faso's First Smart Electricity Network

Ba-Suka Energy delivers affordable, sustainable electricity through smart, swappable SIRA™ batteries — powering electric mobility, businesses, and homes. We are building an advanced, customer-driven network powered by 100% renewable energy, delivering reliable clean power where grid access fails.

sections.heading: Burkina Faso's *Smart Electricity Network*
sections.intro: Ba-Suka Energy delivers affordable, sustainable power through smart, swappable SIRA™ batteries. Our 100% solar, grid-independent infrastructure is built for the Sahel — powering electric mobility, businesses, and homes where the grid fails.

items.title: SIRA™ Smart Swapping
items.body: Riders arrive at a Swap & Glow™ station and exchange their depleted SIRA™ battery for a fully charged unit in under 60 seconds — assisted by a Yennenga Warrior.

items.title: Pay-Per-Swap Access
items.body: Simple, affordable energy. Pay via mobile money only for the energy you use. No expensive battery ownership costs for riders or business owners.

items.title: The Ba-Suka Academy
items.body: Our Yennenga Warriors complete professional training in PV fundamentals, SIRA™ battery diagnostics, and IoT station management to ensure elite service.

items.title: 100% Solar-Charged
items.body: Ride with 100% renewable energy. Our grid-independent stations ensure you have power even during national grid failures or blackouts.
